title: Run a sample program and check its exit code
description: Use the tutorial’s exit-status pattern with a toy program. This records both a successful run and an expected error.

files.sample.py:
import sys
if len(sys.argv) != 2:
    print("Usage: sample.py VALUE", file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(2)
print(int(sys.argv[1]) * 2)
